name: nerfacc
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: nerfacc
  version: "0.5.3"
  build_number: 13

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/n/nerfacc/nerfacc-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 01850cbbd71b6aeab059cbfb695755f8b6604f3fdfe48c44925b4b97c0c324db
    patches:
      - patches/0001-Avoid-std-lerp-conflict.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  # Upstream only provides a CUDA extension. CUDA 11.8 is outside this
  # feedstock's current PyTorch CUDA matrix.
  skip:
    - cuda_compiler_version == "None" or cuda_compiler_version == "11.8"
    # PyTorch 2.13's Windows CUDA 12 build is pinned to CUDA 12.8, while the
    # conda-forge compiler matrix currently provides 12.9 and 13.0 here.
    - win and cuda_compiler_version != "13.0"
  script:
    file: ${{ "build.bat" if win else "build.sh" }}

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: ${{ compiler("cuda") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cmake
    - ninja
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - pip
        - pybind11
        - python
        - "pytorch ${{ pytorch }}.* *cuda*"
        - setuptools
  host:
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then:
        - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - libcublas-dev
        - libcurand-dev
        - libcusolver-dev
        - libcusparse-dev
    - pip
    - python
    - "pytorch ${{ pytorch }}.* *cuda*"
    - setuptools
  run:
    - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
      then: cuda-cudart
    - python
    - "pytorch ${{ pytorch }}.* *cuda*"
    - rich >=12
    - typing_extensions

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - nerfacc
      pip_check: true

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/nerfstudio-project/nerfacc
  summary: A General NeRF Acceleration Toolbox in PyTorch
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE

extra:
  feedstock-name: nerfacc
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jeongseok-meta
